senses.gloss: cause to have, in the abstract sense or physical sense
senses.learner: to cause someone to have something, either a real thing or something you cannot touch.
examples: This letter gave Elizabeth some pain
The long ride in the rain gave her a bad cold.

senses.gloss: transfer possession of something concrete or abstract to somebody
senses.learner: to pass something you have over to another person, so that it is now theirs, whether it is a thing you can touch or one you cannot.
examples: when the living fell, it was given elsewhere

senses.gloss: be the cause or source of
senses.learner: to be the cause of something or the place it comes from.
examples: it gives such an elegance to misfortune
